t: CVD Silicon Carbide – Aymont Technology, Inc.
s: In PVT, source material is loaded into crucibles and sublimed onto a seed crystal. High purity source is required to make high-quality SiC crystals. Aymont offers large particle size SiC specifically for PVT because it has higher density than small-grained material formed by spontaneous combustion of Si and C-containing gases.

t: About us – Aymont Technology, Inc.
s: Aymont Technology is the leading supplier of crystal growth equipment with a commercial process for silicon carbide and similar materials. Founded in 2006, our facilities are located in 15,000 sq. ft. (1,400 square meters) in the Tech Valley region north of Albany, New York, about midway between New York City and Montreal, Quebec.

t: Aymont Technology - Products, Competitors, Financials, Employees, Headquarters Locations
s: Aymont Technology manufactures equipment for silicon carbide crystal growth and CVD source material within the semiconductor equipment industry. Their offerings include induction heated furnaces for silicon carbide crystals and various sizes of CVD source material used in crystal growth processes.
